# S0179: MimiPenguin

<a id="s0179"></a>

Type: tool  
ATT&CK: [S0179](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0179)  
Platforms: Linux  

[MimiPenguin](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0179) is a credential dumper, similar to [Mimikatz](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0002), designed specifically for Linux platforms.
